prior_year_events.event_name: Adjustment of historical excess of loss ceded reinsurance contracts
prior_year_events.impact_description: Delayed recognition of ceded premium adjustments for a limited number of historical excess of loss ceded reinsurance contracts; described as a cumulative adjustment recognised in 2019

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 797.389m (balance sheet). The report does not provide a single explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure labeled as 'movement in prior years' suitable for direct extraction; technical reserves reconciling tables show overall gross changes in claims outstanding during 2019 but do not isolate a gross prioryear development number. Narrative references cite adverse claims development (notably deterioration in Marine & Energy Liability) and issues relating to ceded reinsurance adjustments in 2019 which affected recoveries. As a result the net movement shown in the technical provisions table is small (net -1.034m) but a gross, prior-year-only strengthening/release figure is not clearly stated in gross terms in the report.
raw_causal_phrases: identified the need for recording additional adjustment premiums for a limited number of historical excess of loss ceded reinsurance contracts
delay in the recognition of ceded premium adjustments for these contracts
additional ceded premiums constituted a $11.9m cumulative adjustment in 2019

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, liabilities) - clear and high confidence. The report does not present an explicit GROSS prior-year-only movement figure labelled as 'movement in prior year provision' suitable for extraction. The technical provisions reconciliation shows an overall gross change in claims outstanding during 2019 (gross change GBP 71.765k) but that is the total movement (includes current year development and new claims) and is not the same as 'prior year development' as required by the task. A net prior year movement (net of reinsurance) of -GBP 1.034m is shown in the Technical Provisions table; using that would be net, not gross - per instructions net values are a last resort. Given absence of a clearly labelled gross PYD figure, prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. Claims development triangle is provided and could be used as a last-resort quantitative source to compute PYD, but the report also contains reinsurance and portfolio adjustments (including recognition delays and ceded adjustments) that may distort triangle-derived PYD; users should treat PYD as not directly extractable without further actuarial reconciliation.
